successors.name: Turco-Egyptian Sudan
successors.text: the Nile north of the confluence of the Blue and White Niles, with the Butana approximated by River Nile and Khartoum (as the Funj dossier does)

ledger.x: Late 15th century: Abdallah Jamma'a rebels against Alodia and founds the Abdallabi realm.
1576: 'Ajib beats an Ottoman invasion and presses into Egypt.
1622: the northern frontier is fixed at Hannik.

wars.name: Funj-Abdallab war (Arbaji)
wars.outcome: "The Funj were able to defeat the Abdallabis decisively in a battle near Arbaji in 1504"; the Abdallab became Funj vassals (vassal_start in the funj-sultanate dossier).

wars.name: 'Ajib's war against the Ottomans
wars.outcome: 'Ajib defeated an Ottoman invasion in 1576 and reached Aswan; the northern frontier was fixed at Hannik in 1622.

certainty.note: The Hannik frontier (1622) is the only named boundary.
